rationale: Direction is supportive-long (KOSPI/semis supercycle, macro risk-on) but the entry is a chase, not a setup: RSI 78 on 1h, parabolic ADX 78.7, price pinned at the upper Bollinger band (%B 0.98), +0.84% above VWAP, with a 4h BEARISH divergence and NEGATIVE relative strength (-3.76%). On top of that, Samsung preliminary Q2 earnings print tomorrow (July 7) is a genuine binary that directly drives EWY, into a tape already whipping +/-6-8% intraday as foreigners de-risk. Buying an extended top into an unresolved 24h event with two-way gap risk is negative expectancy: any stop wide enough to survive the gap (~2+ ATR) wrecks R:R, and the gap can jump the stop regardless. No high-probability short either - primary trend is up and a strong print gaps it higher. Highest-expectancy action is to stand aside and wait for the event to resolve or a clean pullback toward VWAP/SMA20 (~188) to buy the trend.

reconsider.note: A pullback to the ~188 VWAP/SMA20 zone would offer a proper trend-continuation long entry with a real stop below support instead of chasing the extended upper band; also re-debate once the Samsung print resolves the binary.
